zakat.claim_evidence: The search results for Islamic Foundation of Nevada primarily describe it as a non-profit organization focused on providing education to elementary and secondary school children and offering burial services. There is no explicit mention of 'zakat' on their donation pages or in their general organizational descriptions. While they received a donation from Islamic Relief USA for shooting victims' expenses, this does not indicate that Islamic Foundation of Nevada itself accepts zakat donations from individuals. Other search results mentioning zakat refer to different organizations, such as 'Islamic Foundation' (with a different contact email and phone number) or 'Islamic Society of Nevada'.

rich_narrative.summary: The Islamic Foundation of Nevada (IFN) serves as a local religious and educational hub, primarily focusing on <cite id="1">elementary and secondary school education</cite> and community burial services. The organization manages a significant financial portfolio, reporting <cite id="2">$3,248,200 in total revenue</cite> for the 2023 fiscal year. While it maintains a <cite id="3">73/100 overall score from Charity Navigator</cite>, recent data indicates a transition period, as revenue <cite id="4">declined by 17% to $2,694,313</cite> in the following year. IFN operates with a <cite id="5">program expense ratio of 75.5%</cite>, which is notably lower than the <cite id="6">89.8% peer program ratio median</cite> for similar global education and religious organizations. Despite this, the foundation demonstrates high efficiency in its development efforts, reporting <cite id="7">$0.00 spent to raise every $1</cite> in donations. Beyond education, the foundation engages in community welfare, including <cite id="8">providing 650 Thanksgiving meals</cite> and supporting <cite id="9">health literacy for 55,000 individuals</cite> through its outreach programs. Its long-term stability is anchored by <cite id="10">$6,265,666 in total assets</cite>, providing a substantial safety net for its local operations.
